author: researcher
excerpt: The bar graph defaults to D for daily. Tap W at the top of the chart to view your sleep history for the past week. You can also tap M or 6M to view your history for the past month or 6 months.
observation: Apple Support article 'Track your sleep on Apple Watch and use Sleep on iPhone', published September 14, 2026 (redirected to /en-us/108906). The Health app sleep bar graph has D, W, M and 6M views; W shows sleep history 'for the past week'. 'Show More Sleep Data' > Amounts shows Sleep Duration details such as Sleep Goal and Time Asleep. It says that if the watch is not worn to sleep the graph might not show any data.
limitations: Vendor help text, not observed in the app. The current page does not mention a weekly average value, how nights without data are treated in any average, whether 'past week' is a calendar week or the last 7 days, or any comparison with the previous week.
